[[File:fusion_lantern.png|thumb|A fusion lantern]]
The '''fusion lantern''' or '''fusion lamp''' was a handheld light and heat source. Larger than a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], it weighed two [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and illuminated a ten-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius. From [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], fusion lanterns were available for 25 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fusion lamps were used on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]] by members of the organization of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rufus Trammel]].
